p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); p.write_text('def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    starts=[0,3,6,9,12]
    color=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row if v!=0), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    for row in out:
        for k in range(2):
            vals=[row[c+k] for c in starts]
            value=color if vals.count(color)>len(vals)/2 else 0
            for c in starts: row[c+k]=value
    return out
')
